_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gardens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "area_m2" REAL NULL, "soil_texture" TEXT NULL, "ph" REAL NULL, "ph_measured_at" TEXT NULL, "sun_exposure" TEXT NULL, "irrigation" TEXT NULL, "covered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("covered" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES zones (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "harvest_qty" REAL NULL, "harvest_unit" TEXT NULL, "cost_czk" REAL NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "activity_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES activities (id), "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES zones (id), "due" TEXT NOT NULL, "remind_at" INTEGER NULL, "rrule" TEXT NULL, "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "notes" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_activity_id" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "duration_est_min" INTEGER NULL, "tools" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_qty" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "low_stock_threshold" REAL NULL, "details" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_materials" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_materials" ("activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activities (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("activity_id", "item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_threads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "garden_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES gardens (id), "title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_threads (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "context_summary" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent', "feedback" TEXT NULL, "feedback_comment" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
